paraphrase: The forty sacraments are: the eight from conception to initiation, the four Vedic vows, the final bath, marriage, the five great sacrifices, and the seven cooked-food, seven oblation and seven Soma sacrifices. The eight virtues of the self are compassion for all beings, patience, freedom from envy, purity, calm, auspiciousness, freedom from meanness and freedom from greed. One who has the forty sacraments but not the eight virtues does not reach union with Brahman or his world; one who has only some sacraments but the eight virtues does.
